reports.title: Pastor Paul Mackenzie convicted in Shakahola Forest deaths
reports.description:
Kenyan self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie and 28 co-accused were found guilty of 191 counts of murder. The case stemmed from investigations launched in 2023 after authorities uncovered mass graves and rescued starving followers associated with Mackenzie’s Good News International Church.

reports.title: Talk Africa: The mystery of cults
reports.description:
Cults have been in existence for hundreds of years. Their leaders stand accused of distorting religious doctrines, which has often led followers to tragic ends. This week on Talk Africa, we delve deeper into the mystery of cults, exploring how they operate and why they have persisted.
